segments.cap: LeaguePour runs bar leagues and tournaments, from signup to standings.
segments.tts: League Pour runs bar leagues and tournaments, from signup to standings.

segments.cap: Start with the free tools. No account needed. Type your team names into the double elimination bracket generator, and it builds the winners and losers brackets for you.
segments.tts: Start with the free tools. No account needed. Type your team names into the double elimination bracket generator, and it builds the winners and losers brackets for you.

segments.cap: Click a winner and they advance. The loser drops into the losers bracket. To run the night online, create a venue account.
segments.tts: Click a winner, and they advance. The loser drops into the losers bracket. To run the night online, create a venue account.

segments.cap: Signing up takes four fields: your name, email, a password and your venue's name. No credit card.
segments.tts: Signing up takes four fields. Your name, email, a password, and your venue's name. No credit card.

segments.cap: Next, create a competition: name it, pick the game and choose a format. Single elimination brackets and round robin schedules are built for you.
segments.tts: Next, create a competition. Name it, pick the game, and choose a format. Single elimination brackets and round robin schedules are built for you.

segments.cap: Set a $0 entry fee, or charge one through Stripe once you connect it. Then publish.
segments.tts: Set a zero dollar entry fee, or charge one through Stripe once you connect it. Then publish.

segments.cap: Your event gets a public page and a QR code. Players register from their phone with a free player account. No app to download.
segments.tts: Your event gets a public page and a QR code. Players register from their phone with a free player account. No app to download.

segments.cap: When signup closes, press Start Tournament. Round one is generated from your registrations. Enter each score, and winners move on.
segments.tts: When signup closes, press Start Tournament. Round one is generated from your registrations. Enter each score, and winners move on.

segments.cap: Players follow results on the public page, or on a live scoreboard on the bar TV.
segments.tts: Players follow results on the public page, or on a live scoreboard on the bar TV.

segments.cap: Your first active competition is free, with every feature. Paid plans start at $29 a month to run more at once. $0 events have no fees.
segments.tts: Your first active competition is free, with every feature. Paid plans start at twenty nine dollars a month to run more at once. Free events have no fees.

segments.cap: Start free at leaguepour.com. Or try the bracket generator first.

segments.cap: VenueSprocket helps restaurants, bars and breweries book private events.
segments.tts: Venue Sprocket helps restaurants, bars and breweries book private events.

segments.cap: Create a free account with your name, email, a password and your venue's name. Your inquiry page is live as soon as you finish.
segments.tts: Create a free account with your name, email, a password, and your venue's name. Your inquiry page is live as soon as you finish.

segments.cap: Share the link, or add a booking button to your website from Settings.
segments.tts: Share the link, or add a booking button to your website from settings.

segments.cap: Here's a guest planning a rehearsal dinner. She picks the event type, date and guest count on her phone, and sends it. No account needed.
segments.tts: Here's a guest planning a rehearsal dinner. She picks the event type, date and guest count on her phone, and sends it. No account needed.

segments.cap: The inquiry lands in your dashboard as a new lead, with the date, guest count and contact details.
segments.tts: The inquiry lands in your dashboard as a new lead, with the date, guest count and contact details.

segments.cap: Turn the lead into an event, then build a proposal: a room fee, a food and beverage minimum, and a deposit. Send it as a secure link.
segments.tts: Turn the lead into an event, then build a proposal. A room fee, a food and beverage minimum, and a deposit. Send it as a secure link.

segments.cap: Your customer reviews the proposal and accepts it online.
segments.tts: Your customer reviews the proposal, and accepts it online.

segments.cap: Generate the contract. The guest signs with a typed signature, then can pay the deposit through Stripe.
segments.tts: Generate the contract. The guest signs with a typed signature, then can pay the deposit through Stripe.

segments.cap: Then build the banquet event order for your team: room setup, food, beverage, staffing and AV, with a print view.
segments.tts: Then build the banquet event order for your team. Room setup, food, beverage, staffing and A V, with a print view.

segments.cap: Free covers your inquiry page and leads. Starter, $29 a month, adds proposals. Pro, $79, adds contracts, deposits and BEOs.
segments.tts: Free covers your inquiry page and leads. Starter, twenty nine dollars a month, adds proposals. Pro, seventy nine, adds contracts, deposits, and B E Os.
